gnex_claim_limit: GNEX MIME types and SKT_GVM:// URI recognition are directly present. A separately loaded GNEX interpreter or execution has not been established; MIME registration alone is not full runtime verification.
game_claim_limit: Five named game files are complete declared native PXO4 modules with Thumb initializer/entry. They are not SGS; no claim of emulator playability, Sinjisoft authorship, or complete external resource/API dependencies.
update_not_user_dump: This is a vendor KDZ/WDB software update, not a populated user-memory partition.

decoder.translation: decode-lglz.py is a bounded Python translation with observed 8192-byte, per-block length framing; retain GPL licence. Original lglz.cpp has a GPL notice but no named copyright line. SVN attribution is retained, not a claim about all authors.
decoder.comparison: lglz-reference64.c is the original decompress subset, with stdafx removed, pointer arithmetic widened to uintptr_t, export decoration. It was compiled locally; no vendor code was loaded. All401 known-valid blocks across8 modules match Python bytes exactly. Unsafe reference decoder was not tested on malformed inputs.
decoder.license_scope: Decoder/reference code licensing does not grant rights to original LG game payloads. Do not put GPL code under the repository MIT licence.
